acceptanceCriteria: requirements inspect REQ-ID returns one requirement in markdown or JSON.
requirements list --ids-only returns IDs without full record bodies.
task|issue|sprint|epic list accept --status, --id, --fields, and --limit in both output modes.
task list --status active --output json costs under 500 tokens on this repository.
--backend github-issues supports create, update, status, and comment mutations, or reports capability False with an explicit refusal naming the human-only boundary.
Capability flags reported by project summary match actual behavior for every backend.
Existing callers are unaffected: omitting the new flags preserves current output.
notes: GitHub issue #178. Sprint assignment deferred: no Sprint is currently Active (workspace config names closed SP-023/EP-018).
rationale: Read amplification is the dominant token cost in planning and documentation work. AICockpit offers no single-record or filtered read, and the github-issues backend supports no mutations, routing agents to raw gh outside the AICockpit authority model.

workItem.title: Add granular read primitives and close the github-issues mutation gap in AICockpit
